subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): onModelDiagnosticEvent for trusted model.* events

question: Should OpenClaw accept an observability-only diagnostic-runtime stream that lets plugins subscribe to allowlisted trusted model lifecycle diagnostics, or should model usage and cost plugins wait for a narrower usage-ledger or provider-owned usage contract?
rationale: The code path is narrow and proof-backed, but the new plugin SDK surface exposes trusted-looking provider/model/session/cost telemetry and becomes a released compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept the diagnostics stream
options.body: After the SDK artifacts are fixed, merge this as an observability-only stream with the documented non-integrity caveat while keeping the native ledger as separate work.

options.title: Require a narrower usage contract
options.body: Pause this PR and route usage/cost plugins to a future provider-owned or native ledger API instead of exposing trusted diagnostics directly.

options.title: Accept both with explicit docs
options.body: Allow this cross-provider diagnostics stream for observability and separately design the native durable ledger for accounting, retention, and backfill.

recommendation.title: Accept the diagnostics stream
recommendation.body: After the SDK artifacts are fixed, merge this as an observability-only stream with the documented non-integrity caveat while keeping the native ledger as separate work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest git-history connection to the diagnostic-runtime SDK seam and generated SDK baseline policy.
